FireFusion WA 1000m
	

Daily spatio-temporal datacube for wildfire ignition and cause prediction over Washington State, an envelope spanning the Puget lowlands east to the Idaho border. Ten geospatial products spanning terrain, fuels, weather, human activity, lightning, and fire history are aggregated onto a single daily 1km by 1km grid covering every fire season 2003-2020.
